Item.Name: DRIVE_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter drive date in 'MMDDYYYY' format.
Item.Label: Donor Id

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp boolean;
begin
bell;
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 IF :global.double IS NULL THEN
 :global.double := TO_CHAR(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 message('Re-enter value');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE

 ---MESSAGE(:global.double );PAUSE;
 ---message('Second entry='||TO_CHAR(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY'));pause;

 IF :global.double != nvl(TO_CHAR(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY'),'X') THEN
 :global.double := '';

 if form_success then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 SHOW_ERROR('16000');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 else
 null;
 end if;

 ELSE

 if not(validate_drive_date) then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :global.double := '';
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 else
 temp := show_lov('LOV_DRIVES'); 
 if temp then
 erase('global.double');
 next_item;
 else
 :sponsor := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
:total := 0;
exception
 when value_error then
 null;
 when others then
 HANDLE_ERROR;
end;

DECLARE
 szBatchId VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 :Global.initial_scheme:=null; --This variable is used in all the validate-item of unit fields

 If :ctrl_block_1.drive_id != :ctrl_block_1.d_drive_id then
 SHOW_ERROR('12040');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.drive_date');
 clear_record;
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 Else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no',displayed,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 if :GLOBAL.BATCH_REGISTER='Y' then -- This if stmt. was added by ED on 04/05/2001
 select location_id into :ctrl_block_1.s_location_id from drives -- to generalise for batch and no batch
 where drive_id=:ctrl_block_1.drive_id;
 next_item;
 :ctrl_block_1.s_first_no:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.first_no:=null;
 else
 create_ids('BAT',szBatchId); -- Batch Id will be created here if not batch mode
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id := szBatchId;
 :ctrl_block_1.start_time := sysdate;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 end if;
 End if;
EXCEPTION when others then 
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_donor_decision_code_desc VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5); -- Added by Edwin for ISBT128 03/13/2001

BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :ctrl_block_1.s_first_no != 'M' THEN
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value := 'DONOR'; 
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:ctrl_block_1.s_first_no ,'S','*',temp_unit,temp_unit_chk_digit);
 check_package_failure;

 If :GLOBAL.code_scheme <> :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar then 
 show_error('16212');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then ---Added by Edwin 03.13.2001
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit||temp_unit_chk_digit;
 Else
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End if; 

 END IF;
 :Global.initial_scheme:=:Global.isbt_or_codabar; --added by edwin on 03.13.2001 to check against other scan scheme 
EXCEPTION
 when others then
 :ctrl_block_1.s_first_no := null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := null; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 no_days number; 
 v_screen_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 -- item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no','D');
 --set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no',displayed,property_false);
 Begin
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UNIT';
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 synchronize;
 
 IF :Global.code_scheme!='I' THEN -- if Codabar by Edwin on 03/13/2001

 -- Check all the digits are nummeric

 If not(number_check(:ctrl_block_1.first_no)) then 

 -- if not , Check the last 5 digits are numeric 
 if not(number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,-5))) then 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_first_no:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16003');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 else 
 null; --- Last 5 digits are numeric
 end if;

 Else
 NULL; --- Means all numeric
 End if;

 ELSE -- if ISBT

 /* This validation was added by Edwin on 03.14.2001 for ISBT check*/

 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,1,5)) then 
 clear_item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_first_no:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 End if;

 if not(number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,8,6))) then 
 show_error('16207');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then 
 v_screen_unit_id:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,1,13);
 Else
 v_screen_unit_id:=:ctrl_block_1.first_no;
 End if;
 
 Begin 
 
 select 'temp' into temp from donations 
 where unit_id = v_screen_unit_id and
 coll_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) - no_days and
 trunc(chp_sysdate);-- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;comment by ash

 clear_item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no','E');
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 
 
 show_error('16005');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 Exception 
 WHEN too_many_rows then
 
 show_error('16005');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 WHEN no_data_found then 
 synchronize;
 next_item;
 End;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Modified on 10.04.2001 Batch registration allowed for both codabar units,numeric as well as aplhanumeric. If it is 
 numeric take it as is . If it is alphanumeric, the last 5 digit must be numeric and the first two aplphabets must
 be the same for both the units Ex: KZ10001 Last unit- KZ10010

 In between alphabets are not allowed 
*/

DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 set_id varchar2(10);
 no_days number; 
 v_screen_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 -- item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','D');
 -- set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_false);
 
 begin
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UNIT';
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 
 IF :Global.code_scheme='I' then 
 v_screen_unit_id := substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,1,13);

 /* This validateion was added by Edwin on 03.14.2001 for ISBT check*/
 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,1,5)) then 
 clear_item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_last_no:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 end if;

 if not number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,6,8)) THEN
 Clear_Item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no');
 Clear_Item;
 show_error('16211');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 if to_number(substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,6,8)) < to_number(substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,6,8)) THEN
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 execute_trigger('key-prev-item');
 show_error('16004');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if; 
 
 ELSE --codabar 

 v_screen_unit_id := :ctrl_block_1.last_no;

-- Step:1 Check the unit formats are correct (eiterh all numeric or only the last 5 digits are numeric)

 IF not(number_check(:ctrl_block_1.last_no)) then 
 
 -- if not all the digits are numeric, 
 -- check for the first two digits are alphabet and the last 5 digits are numeric

 If not(number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no, -5))) then 
 Clear_Item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no');
 Clear_Item;
 show_error('16003');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 Else
 -- If the first two digits are alphabet and the last 5 digits are numeric, check for sequence

 if to_number(substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no, -5)) < to_number(substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no, -5)) THEN
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 execute_trigger('key-prev-item');
 show_error('16004');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 End if;

 ELSE

 -- If all the digits are numeric, check for the sequence

 if to_number(:ctrl_block_1.last_no) < to_number(:ctrl_block_1.first_no) THEN
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 execute_trigger('key-prev-item');
 show_error('16004');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 END IF;

-- Step:2 Check Batch is possible or not

 If is_batch_eligible then 
 null;
 Else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_last_no:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.last_no:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16209');
 End if; 
 
 END IF;

 Begin 
 select 'temp' into temp from donations where unit_id = v_screen_unit_id and
 coll_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) - no_days and trunc(chp_sysdate);
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; comment by ash
 Clear_Item;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no','E');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no');
 Clear_Item;
 
 show_error('16005');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 create_ids('BAT',set_id);
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id := set_id;
 :ctrl_block_1.start_time := sysdate;
 when too_many_rows then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no',displayed,property_true);
 
 show_error('16005');
 previous_item; 
 Clear_Item;
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 End; 
 synchronize;
 NEXT_ITEM;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_donor_decision_code_desc VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_code_scheme VARCHAR2(2);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :ctrl_block_1.s_UNIT_ID != 'M' THEN
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value := 'DONOR'; 
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:ctrl_block_1.s_UNIT_ID ,'S','*',temp_unit,temp_unit_chk_digit);
 check_package_failure;
 -- :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;

 IF :Global.initial_scheme is not null then -- Initial scheme is defined in the s_first_no validiate-field trigger
 If :Global.initial_scheme!= :Global.code_scheme then
 show_error('9725');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 Else -- find what is the eligible code scan Meaning if not a batch mode
 FIND_ISBT_OR_CODABAR(:global.chapter_id,temp_code_scheme);
 if temp_code_scheme <> :Global.code_scheme then 
 show_error('16212');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then ---Added by Edwin 03.13.2001
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit||temp_unit_chk_digit;
 Else
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End if;

 END IF;

exception
 when others then
 :ctrl_block_1.s_UNIT_ID := null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := null; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

 --

 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');

 /* This validation was added by Edwin on 03.14.2001 for ISBT check*/
 IF :Global.code_scheme = 'I' then 
 If not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 End if;

 if not number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 end if; 
 ELSE -- for codabar
 If :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme = 'A' then 
 if substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,2)!=substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,1,2) then
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16006'); 
 end if;
 End if;


 END IF;

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','D');

 Begin
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days
 from valid_parameters where parameter_code = 'UNIT' ;
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then 
 v_screen_unit_id:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 v_screen_unit_id:=:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 End if;

 select 'temp' into temp /*check if entered already */
 from donations
 where (unit_id = v_screen_unit_id or void_unit_id = v_screen_unit_id) and 
 (coll_date+0 between trunc(chp_sysdate)- no_days and trunc(chp_sysdate)) ;
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; comment by ash
 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;

 show_error('16005');

EXCEPTION 

 WHEN no_data_found then
 IF :Global.BATCH_REGISTER='N' then
 go_block('find_donors');
 ELSE
 If :GLOBAL.code_scheme ='I' then 
 pl_current_unit:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,6,8);
 pl_first_unit:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no,6,8);
 pl_last_unit:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no,6,8);
 Else
 if :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme = 'N' then
 pl_current_unit :=:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 pl_first_unit :=:ctrl_block_1.first_no;
 pl_last_unit :=:ctrl_block_1.last_no;
 else
 pl_current_unit := substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id , -5);
 pl_first_unit := substr(:ctrl_block_1.first_no , -5);
 pl_last_unit := substr(:ctrl_block_1.last_no , -5);
 end if;

 End if;

 UNIT_VALIDATION(pl_current_unit, pl_first_unit, pl_last_unit );

 END IF;

 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 clear_item;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 
 show_error('16005');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/**********************************************************************************************
* Modified on 10/16/97
*
* According to the settings in the FIND_DONOR_PROGRAMS and system parameters
* the fields are enabled or disabled.
*
* Modified on 03/13/2011
* Special Scanning code added; Based on global configuration table.
*
*
* Modified on 02/24/2012
* global.alt_id and global.alt_type variable initialized. IM:6197 - Find Donor Version : 13
*
***********************************************************************************************/

DECLARE
 new_donor varchar2(1);
 grading_level varchar2(10);
 NEW_B varchar2(1); 
 SELECT_B varchar2(1); 
 HOLD_B varchar2(1); 
 SELECT_L number; 
 NEW_L number; 
 SELECT_ML number;
 entries number;
 r_chk varchar2(1);
 f_chk varchar2(1);
 P_did varchar2(1);
 P_fname varchar2(1);
 chp_sysdate DATE;

BEGIN
 -- Added on 05/06/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
 
 :GLOBAL.CONFRM_FLD:=null;
 :GLOBAL.SPECIAL_SCANNING := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.SINGLE_USER := NULL;
 
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_ID');
 -- IM:6197
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.ALT_ID');
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.ALT_TYPE');
 
 -- SCR 151981
 :GLOBAL.ALT_ID := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.ALT_ID_TYPE := NULL;
 ----
 -- MLT 2470
 :GLOBAL.ALT_TYPE := NULL;
 --
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 04 ]'); --scr 1159
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 13 ]'); 
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 15 ]'); --SCR 19060. find_donors block modified to make all fields in multi-record detail block display only except GRD field.
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 16 ]'); -- SCR 11774 alt ID , type fields added.
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 17 ]'); -- IM:9745 - SCR 11774 alt ID , type fields added.
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 18 ]'); -- IM:9746, 9748; 10/27/2013; 
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 19 ]'); -- SCR 151981 (global.alt_id and global.alt_id_type are initialized to null)
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 20 ]'); -- MLT 2470 global.alt_type initialized to null.
 --set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 21 ]'); -- MLT 2594 ALT_ID and ALT_TYPE fields filpped issue.
 set_window_property('windowfd',title,'Find Donor [Ver: 22 ]'); -- MLT 5915 -- Raising no donor exception if donor is not found. check for V14.
 Begin 
 /* -- 04/04/2018 (Parameter not used anymore)
 begin
 set_block_property('find_donors',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_true);
 select parameter_value into p_did from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'DONID'
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id;
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 */
 
 begin
 select parameter_value into p_fname from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'FNAME'
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id;
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 
 :GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE:=null; 
 
 -- Added on 03/13/2011; special scanning field;
 begin
 select nvl(special_scanning,'N') into :GLOBAL.SPECIAL_SCANNING from lt_application_config
 where upper(appl_id) = 'LIFETRAK';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.SPECIAL_SCANNING := 'N';
 when others then
 :GLOBAL.SPECIAL_SCANNING := 'N';
 end;
 
 if nvl(:global.special_scanning,'N') not in ('N','Y') then
 show_error('21137');
 check_package_failure;
 --message('M4.7 Invalid Value in Special Scanning Field.');
 end if;
 -------
 
 -- Added on 03/30/2011; Single User Field;
 begin
 select nvl(single_user,'N') into :GLOBAL.SINGLE_USER from lt_application_config
 where upper(appl_id) = 'LIFETRAK';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.SINGLE_USER := 'N';
 when others then
 :GLOBAL.SINGLE_USER := 'N';
 end;
 -------
 
 --Get BC_SCAN_REQ check if the BC is going to use the scan id for donors
 begin
 select Upper(parameter_value) into :GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code='BC_SCAN_RE' and chp_sysdate between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id ;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('21088');
 exit_form; 
 end;
 
 
 -- added on 12/20/2010; LT4.7;
 ---Get the BC_SCAN ID prefix
 IF Nvl(:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE,'N') in('Y','y') then ---Get the BC_SCAN ID prefix
 Begin
 select parameter_value into :GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_ID from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code='BC_SCAN_ID' and chp_sysdate between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id;
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('21086');
 exit_form; 
 End;
 END IF; 
 
 
 --get the protected entry to decide if the confirmation entry is required or not
 begin
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.CNFRM_DID');
 select nvl(protected_entry,'N') into :GLOBAL.CNFRM_DID from find_donor_fields 
 where program_name=:banner.prog_name and field_name='D_DONOR_ID';
 exception when others then
 :GLOBAL.CNFRM_DID:='N';
 end;

 

 /* if p_did = 'N' then
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',enabled,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 else
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',Navigable,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',Navigable,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end if;
 */

 if p_fname = 'N' then
 set_item_property('find_donors.first_name',Displayed,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 -- set_item_property('find_donors.f_n',Displayed,PROPERTY_FALSE); -- Commented by Touqeer for Gray color on Dated: 02/10/2009 in onilkreg; Ashok:12/20/2010;
 else
 -- set_item_property('find_donors.f_n',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); -- Commented by Touqeer for Gray color on Dated: 02/10/2009 in onilkreg; Ashok: 12/20/2010; 
 set_item_property('find_donors.first_name',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.first_name',navigable,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end if;


 Exception
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 End;

 set_block_property('find_donors',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 if :system.trigger_item = 'FIND_DONORS.LAST_NAME' then
 go_item('FIND_DONORS.PB_CLEAR');
 set_item_property('find_donors.last_name',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.last_name',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_item('FIND_DONORS.LAST_NAME');
 else
 set_item_property('find_donors.last_name',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.last_name',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end if;

 set_item_property('find_donors.date_of_birth',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.gender',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 set_item_property('find_donors.date_of_birth',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.gender',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);



 -- SCR 11774

 :FIND_DONORS.S_ALTID_MODE := NULL;
 BEGIN
 
 -- get the ALT ID mode parameter.
 begin
 SELECT parameter_value into :find_Donors.s_altid_mode from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'ALTID_MODE' and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id ;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('16333');
 exit_form;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 -- SCR 11774; 
 -- default settings for alt id, alt type, ssn display.
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_ID', 'E');
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_TYPE', 'E');
 
 
 IF :find_donors.s_altid_mode = 'A' THEN
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_ID', 'E');
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_TYPE', 'E');
 ELSE 
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_ID', 'D');
 item_change('FIND_DONORS.S_ALT_TYPE', 'D');
 END IF;
 

 -------------------- 
 
 END;
 
 --
 
 select allow_create,grading_level,ALLOW_NEW,ALLOW_SELECT,
 ALLOW_HOLD,SELECT_ALLOWED_LEVELS,NEW_ALLOWED_LEVEL,
 SELECT_ALLOWED_MULTILEVEL
 into new_donor,grading_level, NEW_B, SELECT_B, 
 HOLD_B , SELECT_L,NEW_L, SELECT_ML
 from find_donor_programs
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name; 
 
 if new_donor = 'N' then
 set_item_property('find_donors.PB_NEW',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if;
 set_block_property('find_donors',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 
 
 set_NAVIGATION('find_donors.date_of_birth','T');
 set_NAVIGATION('find_donors.gender','T');
 
 ---------------
 go_item('find_donors.last_name'); --just to move the navigation
 set_item_property('find_donors.alt_id', CONCEAL_DATA, property_false); -- This property is set to false based on scan string type.
 If NVL(:global.special_scanning, 'N') in ('N', 'n') then
 set_item_property('find_donors.scan_id',visible, property_true);
 item_change('find_donors.scan_id','E');
 set_item_property('find_donors.scan_id_back',visible, property_true);
 item_change('find_donors.scan_id_back', 'E');
 set_item_property('find_donors.sp_scan_id', visible, property_false);
 Else
 set_item_property('find_donors.scan_id', visible, property_false);
 set_item_property('find_donors.scan_id_back', visible, property_false);
 set_item_property('find_donors.sp_scan_id', visible, property_true);
 item_change('find_donors.sp_scan_id', 'E');
 End if;
 ---------------- 
 
 /*********************** Skip donor id if not required ***********************/
 
 IF nvl(:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE,'N') = 'N' then --If scan ID feature is not enabled - do the usual way
 go_item('find_donors.last_name'); --just to move the navigation
 If NVL(:global.special_scanning,'N') in ('N', 'n') then
 item_change('find_donors.scan_id','D');
 item_change('find_donors.scan_id_back','D');
 Else
 item_change('find_donors.sp_scan_id', 'D');
 End If;
 get_properties('D_DONOR_ID',entries,r_chk,f_chk);
 If r_chk = 'N' and f_chk = 'N' then
 -- go_item('find_donors.last_name'); -- SCR 11774
 -- SCR 11774
 IF :find_donors.s_altid_mode IN ('A') THEN 
 go_item('find_donors.s_alt_type');
 ELSE
 --go_item('find_donors.s_alt_type');
 go_item('find_donors.last_name'); -- MLT 7887
 null;
 END IF;
 -----
 Else
 declare
 allow_yn valid_parameters.parameter_value%type;
 BEGIN
 select parameter_value
 into allow_yn
 from valid_parameters 
 where PARAMETER_CODE = 'FD_PRVFLD'
 --and CHAPTER_ID = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id
 and PARAMETER_TYPE = 'ALL'
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 if allow_yn = 'Y' then
 go_item('find_donors.last_name'); -- This is just to get rid of the navigation error: Added on 03-17-05
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',ENABLED,property_true);
 go_item('find_donors.d_donor_id');
 else
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',ENABLED,property_false);
 -- go_item('find_donors.last_name'); -- SCR 11774
 -- SCR 11774
 IF :find_donors.s_altid_mode IN ('A') THEN -- SCR 11774
 --go_item('find_donors.ssn_disp'); -- MLT 7887
 go_item('find_donors.s_alt_type'); -- MLT 7887
 ELSE
 --go_item('find_donors.s_alt_type');
 go_item('find_donors.last_name'); -- MLT 7887
 END IF;
 -----
 end if;
 EXCEPTION
 When others then
 set_item_property('find_donors.d_donor_id',ENABLED,property_false); 
 END;
 End if;
 ELSE
 If NVL(:global.special_scanning,'N') in ('N', 'n') then
 GO_ITEM('FIND_DONORS.SCAN_ID_BACK'); --If SCAN ID feature is enabled
 Else
 GO_ITEM('FIND_DONORS.SP_SCAN_ID'); 
 End If; 
 END IF;
 
 set_item_property('find_donors.PB_NEW',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('find_donors.PB_SELECT',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 if hold_b = 'Y' then
 set_item_property('find_donors.PB_HOLD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 else
 set_item_property('find_donors.PB_HOLD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 end if;
 -- in case of reviewing multiple matches 
 default_value('','GLOBAL.LAST');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.FIRST');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.DOB');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.GENDER');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.S_ALT_TYPE'); -- SCR 11774
 default_value('','GLOBAL.S_ALT_ID'); -- SCR 11774

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 MESSAGE(:BANNER.PROG_NAME);
 PAUSE;
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

DECLARE
 tempTrans donations.transaction_id%TYPE;
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300) := 'Donor was registered in the Onsite Module. DO you want to release the previous donations?'; 
 alert_id Alert; 
 alert_button Number; 

begin

---- new code started staa
 select transaction_id into tempTrans from donations where
 donor_id=:donors.donor_id and coll_date=:drive_date and
 unit_id is not null and program_id='ONPLKREG' and rownum=1;

--'Donor was registered in the Onsite Module. DO you want to release the previous donations?'
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_OR_NO');

 delete from donation_interdictions where transaction_id=tempTrans;
 delete from health_history where transaction_id=tempTrans;
 delete from physical_findings where transaction_id=tempTrans; 
 delete from graded_donations where transaction_id=tempTrans;
 delete from graded_donors where transaction_id=tempTrans; 
 delete from donations where transaction_id=tempTrans;
 END IF; 
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN 
 null;
 END IF;

exception when no_data_found then 
 null;
 when others then 
 handle_error;

end;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DONOR_ADDRESSES 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :DONORS.DONOR_ID;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 FETCH DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DONORS.DONOR_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DONORS.R_DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 
 CLEAR_SCREEN EXCEPTION;
 age_yrs number:=0;
 age_month number:=0;
 p_chp_sysdate date;
 
 Procedure enable_scan is
 Begin
 If :GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE = 'Y' then
 SET_navigation('donor_addresses.scan_id','T');
 SET_item_property('donor_addresses.scan_id',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 go_item('donors.last_name');
 Else
 SET_item_property('donor_addresses.scan_id',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 SET_item_property('donor_addresses.scan_id',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 End If;
 End enable_scan;

 

BEGIN
IF :global.trg_exected='NO' then
 --Added by AV on 05/14/2011;
 :global.trg_exected:='YES'; -- this flag is to avoid executing this trigger when you coming after to this screen and navigate inside the block
 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id',displayed,property_true);
 
 
 If (:global.action = 'SELECT') then
 If :system.block_status not in ('CHANGED','QUERY') then
 execute_query;
 go_item('donors.FIRST_name');
 SET_item_property('donors.last_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 SET_item_property('donors.last_name',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 
 SET_item_property('donors.date_of_birth',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 SET_item_property('donors.date_of_birth',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 
 SET_item_property('donors.gender',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 SET_item_property('donors.gender',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 item_change('donors.gender', 'D'); -- IM 10091 
 
 SET_item_property('donors.donor_weight',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'normal');
 SET_item_property('donors.donor_weight',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 
 end if;
 
 --enable_scan;
 check_online_donation; --- SCR# 16204 --- staa
 
 End if;
 
 If (:global.action = 'NEW') then
 
 go_item('donors.FIRST_name');
 
 SET_navigation('donors.last_name','T');
 SET_item_property('donors.last_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL'); 
 SET_navigation('donors.date_of_birth','T');
 SET_item_property('donors.date_of_birth',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 SET_navigation('donors.gender','T');
 SET_item_property('donors.gender',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 go_item('donors.LAST_name');

 enable_scan;
 go_item('donors.LAST_name');
 End if;
 
 If (:global.action = 'HOLD') then
 Place_donation_holds('NODON'); /*** place a hold on donations for no donor attached***/
 GO_BLOCK('DONATIONS');
 End if;
END IF;
SYNCHRONIZE; 
 p_chp_sysdate:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 p_chp_sysdate:=trunc(p_chp_sysdate);
 
 IF :find_donors.date_of_birth is not null then
 --age_yrs:=floor(months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:find_donors.date_of_birth)/12);
 age_yrs:=months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:find_donors.date_of_birth)/12;
 --age_yrs:=Round(age_yrs, 3);
 
 --message ('age='||to_char(age_yrs,'999.99'));pause;
 
 age_month:=floor(mod(months_between(sysdate,:find_donors.date_of_birth),12));
 CHECK_AGE_LIMIT(age_yrs); 
 END IF;
 
 
EXCEPTION -- IM:8579
 WHEN CLEAR_SCREEN then
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.F_UNIT_ID:=null;
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_UNIT_ID:=null;
 go_block('find_donors');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 item_change('CTRL_BLOCK_1.S_UNIT_ID','E');
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLOCK_1.S_UNIT_ID'); 
END;

DECLARE
 temp VARCHAR2 (5);
 err_txt VARCHAR2 (300) := 'Do you want to create new employer?';
 alert_id alert;
 alert_button NUMBER;
 a_value_chosen BOOLEAN;
 intl_count NUMBER;
 chp_sysdate date;
 ------------------------------------------------------------
 procedure populate_emp_addr IS
 t_intl_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 select decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_postal_code, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_city, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_state, null),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', intl_country_name, null),
 nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N') 
 into :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 t_intl_flag
 from donor_employers
 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id;
 
 if t_intL_flag = 'N' then 
 select zip, city, state into :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_ZIP, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_CITY, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.E_STATE
 from valid_city_state where usps_id = :donor_addresses.e_usps_id;
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','D');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 else
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addreses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 end if;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN too_many_rows then message('Duplicate emmployer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!!');
 WHEN others then handle_error; check_package_failure;
 END populate_emp_addr;
 ---------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NULL THEN
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 -- go_item('donations.donation_type');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 DEFAULT_VALUE ('NO', 'global.new_emp');

 IF :GLOBAL.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 --GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.e_city');
 -- IM:8607; Incase an employer international address is already entered.
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country := NULL; 
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_city := null;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := null;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := null;
 :donor_addresses.e_usps_id := 0;
 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 ELSE
 IF :donors.employer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers 
 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id and nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y';
 
 If intl_Count = 0 then --- local employer; 
 select a.employer_id, b.zip, b.city, b.state,a.usps_id 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b 
 where a.employer_id=:donors.employer_id and
 a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and
 a.usps_id = b.usps_id and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','D');
 go_item('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 Else
 select a.employer_id, a.intl_city, a.intl_state, 
 a.intl_postal_code, intl_country_name 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.intl_postal_code, :donor_addresses.country_name
 from donor_employers a
 where a.employer_id=:donors.employer_id and
 a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 End if; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id,alert_message_text,err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);
 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF a_value_chosen THEN
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 MESSAGE('Duplicate employer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 ELSE -- donors.employer_id is null;
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers where employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N')= 'Y';
 
 if intl_count <> 0 then -- international employer; 
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 select a.employer_id, a.intl_city, a.intl_state, 
 a.intl_postal_code, intl_country_name 
 into :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,:donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.intl_postal_code, :donor_addresses.country_name
 from donor_employers a
 where a.employer_name=:donor_addresses.employer_name
 and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1); 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr','E');
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group'); 
 IF :GLOBAL.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 -- If the newly created employer id needs to be deleted
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 
 :donor_addresses.e_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country:= NULL; 
 END IF;
 else ----- local employer
 If :donor_addresses.employer_name is not null then
 select a.employer_id, b.zip, b.city, b.state,a.usps_id into 
 :donor_addresses.employer_id,:donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b 
 where a.employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name and
 a.usps_id = b.usps_id and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group');
 Else
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.ethnic_group'); 
 if :global.new_emp='YES' then --If the newly created employer id needs to be deleted 
 :donors.employer_id:=null; 
 :global.new_emp:='NO';
 end if;
 :donor_addresses.e_city:=null;
 :donor_addresses.e_state:=null;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip:=null;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal:= NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country:= NULL; 
 End if;
 end if; -- international, local check; 
 END IF; -- donors.employer_id or donor_addresses.employer_name
 END IF; -- Globa.new_emp YES OR NO
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'temp'
 INTO temp
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name LIKE :donor_addresses.employer_name || '%'
 AND chp_SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL (term_date,
 chp_SYSDATE + 1);

 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 err_txt :=
 'No match found. Do you want to create new employer?';
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id,
 alert_message_text,
 err_txt
 );
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);

 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'YES';
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :GLOBAL.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 a_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV ('LOV_Employers');

 IF a_value_chosen THEN
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

 DONOR EMPLOYER table at register trigger ***/ 
DECLARE

BEGIN

 Begin

declare
 intl_count NUMBER;
begin
 if :donors.employer_id is not null then
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers where employer_id = :donors.employer_id
 and nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N') = 'Y';
 BEGIN
 if intl_count <> 0 then -- international address;
 --item_change('donor_addresses.e_city','D');
 item_change('donor_addresses.e_zip','D');
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'Y';
 select employer_name, intl_city, intl_state, intl_postal_code, intl_country_name
 into :donor_addresses.employer_name, :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city, :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal, :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country
 from donor_employers 
 where employer_id = :donors.employer_id;
 :donor_addresses.e_city := null;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := null;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := null; 
 else -- local address;
 --item_change('donor_addresses.e_city','E');
 item_change('donor_addresses.e_zip','E'); 
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'N';
 select A.Employer_name,b.zip,b.city,b.state,b.usps_id into :donor_addresses.Employer_name,
 :donor_addresses.e_zip,:donor_addresses.e_city,:donor_addresses.e_state,:donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 from donor_employers a,valid_city_state b where a.employer_id = :donors.employer_id and
 a.usps_id = b.usps_id; 
 end if; 
 EXCEPTION
 When no_data_found then
 null;
 When others then
 handle_error;
 
 END;
 end if; 
end;

 NULL;

Item.Name: DEFERRAL_REASON
Item.Hint: Enter deferral code, separated by [,] if multiple or enter 0 if none.
Item.Label: Deferral Reason

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 v_temp varchar2(5);
 cnt number;
 str_cnt number := 1;
 def_pointer number := 1;
 chp_sysdate date;
 Procedure remove_wrongly_placed is
 begin
 v_temp := get_RHOLD('NODFREASON');
 
 if v_temp != '***' then
 REMOVE_HOLDS(v_temp);
 end if;
 
 End remove_wrongly_placed;

BEGIN
 --
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 if substr(:donations.deferral_reason,
 NVL(length(:donations.deferral_reason), 0)) = ',' then
 SHOW_ERROR('16041');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 IF :donations.deferral_reason != '0' then
 
 if :donations.deferral_reason = '99' then
 place_donation_holds('NODEF');
 end if;
 
 if :donations.deferral_reason != '99' then
 remove_wrongly_placed;
 place_donation_holds('DRDEF');
 end if;
 
 FOR cnt IN 1 .. 99 loop
 if str_cnt > NVL(length(:donations.deferral_reason), 0) then
 exit;
 end if;
 
 def_pointer := INSTR(:donations.deferral_reason,
 ',',
 def_pointer + 1,
 1);
 if def_pointer = 0 then
 begin
 select 'temp'
 into temp
 from health_history_template A, valid_master_codes B
 where ((A.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and
 A.sort_sequence =
 substr(:donations.deferral_reason, str_cnt) and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between a.eff_date and
 nvl(a.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1)) OR
 (to_char(B.sort_sequence_3) =
 substr(:donations.deferral_reason, str_cnt)))
 and rownum = 1
 and b.code_type = 'PHYCD'
 and chp_sysdate between b.eff_date and
 nvl(b.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);
 str_cnt := str_cnt + 10;
 exit;
 end;
 else
 select 'temp'
 into temp
 from health_history_template A, valid_master_codes B
 where ((A.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and
 A.sort_sequence =
 substr(:donations.deferral_reason,
 str_cnt,
 def_pointer - str_cnt) and
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between a.eff_date and
 nvl(a.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1)) OR
 (to_char(B.sort_sequence_3) =
 substr(:donations.deferral_reason,
 str_cnt,
 def_pointer - str_cnt)))
 and rownum = 1
 and b.code_type = 'PHYCD'
 and chp_sysdate between b.eff_date and
 nvl(b.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);
 str_cnt := def_pointer + 1;
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 :donations.deferral_reason := rtrim(:donations.deferral_reason);
 next_item;
 
 ELSE
 :donations.deferral_reason := rtrim(:donations.deferral_reason);
 remove_wrongly_placed;
 REMOVE_HOLDS('DRDEF');
 REMOVE_HOLDS('NOTYP');
 :donations.deferred_thru_date := null;
 :donations.deferral_type := null;
 go_item('donations.screener_id');
 
 END IF;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16041');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Item.Hint: Enter phlebotomist ID or select from LISTVAL. [ Enter 99 if not present or wrong entry ]
Item.Label: Donation Type

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,
 sysdate,
 chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- 
 If :DONATIONS.BLEED_START_TIME_L1 IS not NULL then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 Begin
 temp := get_RHOLD('NOPHLEBO');
 
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;

 IF :donations.bleed_start_phleb_L1 is not null then
 
 if :donations.bleed_start_phleb_L1 = '99' and temp != '***' then
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 next_item;
 else
 select 'temp'
 into temp
 from EMPLOYEES
 where staff_no = :donations.bleed_start_phleb_L1
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);
 
 Begin
 temp := get_RHOLD('NOPHLEBO');
 
 if temp = '***' then
 next_item;
 else
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 next_item;
 end if;
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;
 end if;
 
 ELSE
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 next_item;
 end if;

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('12006');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 when too_many_rows then
 next_item;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

 next_item;

 when no_data_found then

 into temp
 from EMPLOYEES

 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and :ctrl_block_1.drive_date between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);

 if temp = '***' then

 else

 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('16065');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End;
 End if;
 
 ELSE
 IF CHECK_PHLEB_99 THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 navigate_next_item; --next_item;
 END IF;

 when no_data_found then

 when too_many_rows then

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_string varchar2(30);
 v_veni varchar2(5);
 v_start_pos number:=0;
 v_no_of_pos number:=0;
 v_comma varchar2(2);
 v_comma_pos number:=0;

 v_row_count NUMBER:=0;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(5) := 'VENI'; 
 rg_col VARCHAR2(10) := rg_name||'.VCODE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 chp_sysdate date;

 Procedure veni_check(pl_veni in varchar2) is
 v_temp number;
 Begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_attributes_don where attrib_group='VENI' and
 attrib_code=pl_veni and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 if v_temp=0 then
 SHOW_ERROR('16012');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 end if;
 End veni_check; 
 
 
BEGIN
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 

 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group_Row( rg_id, ALL_ROWS ); 
 END IF;

 IF :donations.s_venipuncture is null then
 next_item;
 ELSE

 v_string:=:donations.s_venipuncture||'*';
 v_start_pos:=v_start_pos+1;
 
 Loop
 
 v_no_of_pos:=v_no_of_pos+1;
 
 v_comma:=substr(v_string,v_no_of_pos,1);
 
 v_comma_pos:=v_comma_pos+1;
 
 if v_comma=',' then
 v_veni:=substr(v_string,v_start_pos,v_comma_pos-1);
 veni_check(v_veni);
 check_for_duplicate_veni(v_veni); 
 v_row_count:=v_row_count+1; 
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col, v_row_count,v_veni); 
 
 v_start_pos:=v_no_of_pos+1;
 v_comma_pos:=0;
 end if;


 if v_comma='*' then
 v_veni:=substr(v_string,v_start_pos,v_comma_pos-1);
 veni_check(v_veni);
 check_for_duplicate_veni(v_veni); 
 v_row_count:=v_row_count+1;
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col, v_row_count,v_veni); 

 exit;
 end if;

 End loop;
 next_item;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_donor_decision_code_desc VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_code_scheme VARCHAR2(2);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :donations.s_void_unit_id != 'M' THEN
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value := 'DONOR'; 
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:donations.s_void_unit_id ,'S','*',temp_unit,temp_unit_chk_digit);
 check_package_failure;
 -- :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;

 IF :Global.initial_scheme is not null then
 If :Global.initial_scheme!= :Global.code_scheme then
 show_error('9725');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 Else -- find what is the eligible code scan Meaning if not a batch mode
 FIND_ISBT_OR_CODABAR(:global.chapter_id,temp_code_scheme);
 if temp_code_scheme <> :Global.code_scheme then 
 show_error('16212');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then ---Added by Edwin 03.13.2001
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit||temp_unit_chk_digit;
 Else
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End if;

 END IF;

exception
 when others then
 :donations.s_void_unit_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := null; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 temp_unit number;
 no_days number; 
 v_screen_unit_id varchar2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 IF :donations.void_unit_id is not null then

 IF :Global.isbt_or_codabar='I' then 

 v_screen_unit_id := substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,13);

 if length(:donations.void_unit_id) !=15 then 
 show_error('0312');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;


 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 
 
 if not number_check(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 ELSIF :Global.isbt_or_codabar='C' THEN -- If codabar scheme

 If length(:donations.void_unit_id)= 15 then
 show_error('16212');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 v_screen_unit_id := :donations.void_unit_id;

 IF :GLOBAL.double_check is null then --- First Entry
 v_screen_unit_id := :donations.void_unit_id;
 
 If :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme ='N' then

 if length(:donations.void_unit_id)!=7 then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if not number_check(:donations.void_unit_id) then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 Elsif :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme ='A' then
 if length(:donations.void_unit_id)!=7 then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 :global.double_check:= :donations.void_unit_id;
 clear_item;
 raise form_trigger_failure; 

 ELSE ---Second entry (if double check is not null)

 If NVL(length(:donations.void_unit_id), 0) != NVL(length(:GLOBAL.double_check), 0) THEN
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 If :donations.void_unit_id != :GLOBAL.double_check THEN
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 Null;
 End if;
 END IF;

 END IF; -- For Isbt or codabar check;
 
 validate_void_unit(:donations.void_unit_id); 
 
 Begin 
 :global.double_check:=null;
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UNIT';
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 Exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 End; 

 if (nvl(length(:donations.void_unit_id), 0) != nvl(length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id), 0)) 
 then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 
 select 'temp' into temp /*check if entered already */
 from donations
 where (unit_id = v_screen_unit_id or void_unit_id=v_screen_unit_id) and
 coll_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) - no_days and trunc(chp_sysdate);
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ; comment by ash;
 

 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;

 ELSE -- If not null or null check 
 
 if :global.double_check is not null then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :donations.donor_decision is null and :GLOBAL.cue_permitted='Y' then
 item_change('donations.s_dd','E');
 go_item('donations.s_dd');
 clear_item;
 else
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 end if;
 
 END IF;

EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 IF :donations.void_unit_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.F_unit_id THEN
 clear_item;
 
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 if :donations.donor_decision is null and :GLOBAL.cue_permitted='Y' then
 item_change('donations.s_dd','E');
 go_item('donations.s_dd');
 clear_item;
 else
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 end if;
 End if;

 when too_many_rows then
 clear_item;
 
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 temp_unit number;
 no_days number; 
 szUnitId varchar2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
IF :donations.void_unit_id is not null then

 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','D');
 synchronize;


 IF :Global.code_scheme!='I' THEN -- 

 -- Check all the digits are nummeric

 If not(number_check(:donations.void_unit_id)) then 

 -- if not , Check the last 5 digits are numeric 
 if not(number_check(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,-5))) then 

 item_change('donations.void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16003');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 else 
 null; --- Last 5 digits are numeric
 end if;

 Else
 NULL; --- Means all numeric
 End if;

 ELSE -- if ISBT
 
 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 clear_item;
 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 End if;

 if not(number_check(substr(:donations.void_unit_id,8,6))) then 
 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16207');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 END IF;

 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:donations.void_unit_id,1,13);
 else
 szUnitId:=:donations.void_unit_id;
 End if;
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:= :donations.void_unit_id; --added

 ---validate_void_unit(:donations.void_unit_id); 
 
 Begin 
 select to_number(parameter_value) into no_days from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'UNIT' ;
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 Exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 End; 

 If (nvl(length(:donations.void_unit_id), 0) != nvl(length(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id), 0)) then
 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('donations.s_void_unit_id');
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure; 
 End if;
 
 select 'temp' into temp /*check if entered already */
 from donations
 where (unit_id = szUnitId or void_unit_id=szUnitId) 
 and coll_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) - no_days and trunc(chp_sysdate) ;
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;comment by ash

 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('donations.s_void_unit_id');
 
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;

 ELSE -- If not null or null check 
 
 if :donations.donor_decision is null and :GLOBAL.cue_permitted='Y' then
 item_change('donations.s_dd','E');
 go_item('donations.s_dd');
 clear_item;
 else
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 end if;
 
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id:= :donations.void_unit_id;

EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 IF :donations.void_unit_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.F_unit_id THEN
 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('donations.s_void_unit_id');
 
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 If :donations.donor_decision is null and :GLOBAL.cue_permitted='Y' then
 item_change('donations.s_dd','E');
 go_item('donations.s_dd');
 clear_item;
 Else
 go_item('donations.s_pass_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 End if;
 End if;

 when too_many_rows then
 set_item_property('donations.s_void_unit_id', DISPLAYED, property_true);
 item_change('donations.s_void_unit_id','E');
 :donations.s_void_unit_id:=null;
 :donations.void_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('donations.s_void_unit_id');
 
 show_error('16005');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_dd_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_dd_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 invalid_scan EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

 If NVL(length(:donations.s_dd), 0) != 7 then
 :donations.s_dd:=null;
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 if :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' then
 begin
 validate_dd_scan_codabar(:donations.s_dd,temp_dd_code,temp_dd_code_desc);
 exception when others then
 raise invalid_scan;
 end;
 else
 validate_dd_scan_code128(:donations.s_dd,temp_dd_code,temp_dd_code_desc);
 end if;

 :donations.donor_cue := temp_dd_code;
 if temp_dd_code in ('Y','N') then
 temp_dd_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 :donations.donor_decision := temp_dd_code_desc;
 End if;

 next_item;
 item_change('donations.s_dd','D');
 set_item_property('donations.s_dd',displayed,property_false); 

EXCEPTION 
 when invalid_scan then
 :donations.s_dd:=null;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_donor_decision_code_desc VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :donations.s_pass_unit_id != 'M' THEN
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value := 'DONOR'; 
 validate_unit_id_coexist(:donations.s_pass_unit_id ,'S','*',temp_unit,temp_unit_chk_digit);
 check_package_failure;
 If :Global.code_scheme='I' then 
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit||temp_unit_chk_digit;
 Else
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 End if;

 If :Global.isbt_or_codabar!= :Global.code_scheme then
 show_error('16212');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;


 END IF;
exception
 when others then
 :donations.s_pass_unit_ID := null;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := null; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/****************************************************************************************
* if the unit does not match with the unit id entered at the begining clear the blocks
* and start all over again. 
* if ok check the eligibility of the donor again. 
* 
* Modified on 05/12/2011; AV; International addr check; employer addr check; create new employer ID logic;
*****************************************************************************************/

DECLARE
 v_batpid VARCHAR (10);
 tr_id VARCHAR (10);
 v_out VARCHAR2 (200);
 place_except EXCEPTION;
 v_screen_unit_id VARCHAR2 (15);
 szfirst VARCHAR2 (15);
 szlast VARCHAR2 (15);
 nexistcount NUMBER := 0;
 idtype VARCHAR2(10);
 emp_id VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure; 
 
 :global.trg_exected:='NO'; --used in the whn-new-block-instance of donor trigger

 /* 
 -- Added on 05/12/2011;AV
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(:donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag,'N')= 'Y' then 
 IF ( :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal IS NULL
 OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NULL 
 ) THEN 
 go_item('donor_addresses.emp_intl_city');
 show_error('0080 ' || ' : International Address');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (:donor_addresses.e_city IS NULL 
 OR :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NULL
 ) THEN 
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.employer_name');
 show_error('0080', ' : City or Zip ');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 ------
 */ 
 
 --item_change('donations.s_pass_unit_id','D');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_pass_unit_id', displayed, property_false);
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 :GLOBAL.new_employer := 'NO';

 --:GLOBAL.new_emp:='NO';
 IF :donations.f_pass_unit_id != :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id THEN /* if the scan missmatch clear record */
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_pass_unit_id', displayed,
 property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_void_unit_id', displayed,
 property_true);
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER ('KEY-CLRFRM');
 show_error ('16015');
 ELSE
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN -- Added by Edwin on 04-25-2001
 v_screen_unit_id := SUBSTR (:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id, 1, 13);
 ELSE
 v_screen_unit_id := :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 END IF;

 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO nexistcount
 FROM donations
 WHERE (unit_id = v_screen_unit_id OR void_unit_id = v_screen_unit_id)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 IF nexistcount = 0 THEN
 :donations.transaction_id := NULL; --Added by Edwin on 03.15.2001
 IF :donations.transaction_id IS NULL THEN /* Generate NEW transaction ID */
 create_ids ('TR', tr_id);
 :donations.transaction_id := tr_id;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.cue_permitted = 'Y' THEN
 IF :donations.donor_decision IS NULL THEN ---if :donations.s_dd is null (old code)
 place_donation_holds ('DNCUE'); /** place a hold on donations for no CUE**/
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'HOLD' THEN /*** if donation on hold then call graded donors***/
 update_graded_tables (v_screen_unit_id);
 ELSE
 IF :donations.donation_type NOT IN ('AU', 'TH') THEN
 donor_eligibility (v_screen_unit_id); /* call eligibility_check only if donor is selected*/
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :donations.deferral_reason NOT IN ('0', '99') AND :donations.donor_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 place_donor_holds (:donations.donor_id, 'DRDEF', NULL);
 END IF;

 IF :donations.deferral_reason NOT IN ('0', '99') THEN
 place_donation_holds ('DRDEF'); /***** donation with deferral ****/
 END IF;

 update_all_tables;
 :donations.end_data_entry_time := SYSDATE;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '10';

 IF NVL (:ctrl_block_1.total, 0) = 0 AND -- modified on 05/30/02 PR# 001013531 By: Edwin
 UPPER (:GLOBAL.batch_register) = 'Y' THEN -- Creates batch only if it is batch
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN -- Added by Edwin on 04-25-2001
 szfirst := SUBSTR (:ctrl_block_1.first_no, 1, 13);
 szlast := SUBSTR (:ctrl_block_1.last_no, 1, 13);
 ELSE
 szfirst := :ctrl_block_1.first_no;
 szlast := :ctrl_block_1.last_no;
 END IF;

 INSERT INTO registration_sets
 (set_id, start_unit_id, end_unit_id,
 chapter_id, program_id,
 start_data_entry_time, end_data_entry_time
 )
 VALUES (:ctrl_block_1.set_id, szfirst, szlast,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :banner.prog_name,
 :ctrl_block_1.start_time, SYSDATE
 );

 INSERT INTO rpt_parm
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name,
 parm_id, parm_date, submit_date, report_status
 )
 VALUES ('DON', :banner.user_id, 'DRRDNBAT',
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 'S'
 );

 INSERT INTO rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name,
 parm_id, parm_no, parm_select,
 parm_code
 )
 VALUES ('DON', :banner.user_id, 'DRRDNBAT',
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id, 1, :ctrl_block_1.set_id,
 'DNBAT'
 );

 INSERT INTO rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name,
 parm_id, parm_no, parm_select, parm_code
 )
 VALUES ('DON', :banner.user_id, 'DRRDNBAT',
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id, 2, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'CHP'
 );
 ELSE
 -- update registration sets table for the end data entry time
 -- added by chandra on 08/14/98
 BEGIN
 UPDATE registration_sets
 SET end_data_entry_time = SYSDATE
 WHERE set_id = :ctrl_block_1.set_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;

 -- The transaction needs to be posted to capture the new donor id
 --when we put DDI on donor (added on 01/26/99 by Edwin)
 BEGIN
 IF :donations.donor_id IS NOT NULL AND :donations.deferral_reason != '0' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'NEW' THEN
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10; -- Added by Touqeer for IM#3118
 POST;
 END IF;

 IF :donations.deferral_type = 'IND' THEN
 place_donor_holds (:donations.donor_id, 'DDI', NULL);
 END IF;

 IF :donations.deferred_thru_date IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :donations.deferred_thru_date > :donations.coll_date THEN
 place_donor_holds (:donations.donor_id,
 'DDT',
 :donations.deferred_thru_date
 );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

 COMMIT;
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_dd', displayed, property_true);
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0; -- staa

 IF FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 IF (:GLOBAL.action = 'HOLD') OR :donation_interdictions.inter_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error ('16098', ' ' || :donations.transaction_id);
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 MESSAGE ('Donation Registered', no_acknowledge);
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_pass_unit_id',
 displayed,
 property_true
 );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_void_unit_id',
 displayed,
 property_true
 );

 IF :GLOBAL.batch_register = 'Y' THEN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.last_no = :donations.f_pass_unit_id THEN
 run_setid_report;
 /* call the batch id report at last unit*/
 CLEAR_FORM (no_validate);
 item_change ('ctrl_block_1.s_first_no', 'E');
 item_change ('ctrl_block_1.s_last_no', 'E');
 item_change ('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id', 'E');
 item_change ('donations.s_pass_unit_id', 'E');
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER ('util_banner');
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_dd',
 displayed,
 property_true
 );
 :ctrl_block_1.id_queue := '';
 --- Added by Touqeer for IM-3117
 clear_form_blocks;
 /********* clears all except control block ************/
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block_1.id_queue := ''; --- Added by Touqeer for IM-3117
 clear_form_blocks;
 /********* clears all except control block ************/
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donations.s_pass_unit_id',
 displayed,
 property_true
 );

* The drive date must be between system date and the PARAMETERISED number of days
* The drive date can not be greater than system date

Y2K Checked and verified 
***************************************************************************************/

FUNCTION validate_drive_date RETURN boolean IS
 temp varchar2(5);
 number_of_days_param number;
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else

 end if;

 Select parameter_value into number_of_days_param from valid_parameters

 --and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;

 if :ctrl_block_1.drive_date < chp_sysdate - number_of_days_param or

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

/************** This procedure is useed to update ******************
 DONOR_EMPLOYERS

*********************************************************************/

BEGIN

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*********************************************************************************************
* If the user is not allowed to select a donor to register **************
* the donation must go into graded donations
* go on hold
* the donor must go into graded donors
* go on hold
**********************************************************************************************/

PROCEDURE update_graded_tables(szTmpUnitId in varchar2) IS
 tr_id varchar2(10);

 cursor dnr_holds is select donor_id from donor_reel where session_id=:find_donors.session_id;

 Procedure place_ddi_ddt(pl_donor_id in varchar2) IS
 v_count NUMBER;
 v_inter VARCHAR2(3);
 v_def_thru_date DATE;
 Begin
 if :donations.deferral_type='IND' then
 v_inter:='DDI';
 v_def_thru_date:=null;
 place_donor_holds(pl_donor_id,v_inter,v_def_thru_date);
 end if;
 If :donations.DEFERRED_THRU_DATE is not null then
 if :donations.DEFERRED_THRU_DATE > :donations.coll_date then
 v_inter:='DDT';
 v_def_thru_date:=:donations.DEFERRED_THRU_DATE;
 place_donor_holds(pl_donor_id,v_inter,v_def_thru_date);
 end if;
 End if;
End place_ddi_ddt;

BEGIN



-- Added by Edwin on 03/15/2001 to incorporat the ISBT 
/* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/23/2013. IM 9499
If :find_donors.LAST_NAME is not null and :find_donors.SSN is not null and
 :find_donors.DATE_OF_BIRTH is not null and :find_donors.gender is not null then
-- End of commented section */
-- Added by Kishore on 10/23/2013. IM 9499
if :find_donors.last_name is not null and 
 :find_donors.date_of_birth is not null and
 :find_donors.gender is not null then
-- End of change

 Insert into graded_donations(TRANSACTION_ID,UNIT_ID,LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME,DATE_OF_BIRTH,
 GENDER,ACTIVE_FLAG,PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id)

 values (:donations.transaction_id, szTmpUnitId,
 :find_donors.LAST_NAME,:find_donors.FIRST_NAME,:find_donors.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
 :find_donors.GENDER,'A',:banner.prog_name,
 :global.chapter_id );

 insert into graded_donors(TRANSACTION_ID,DONOR_ID,DGM_ID,
 PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id )
 select :donations.transaction_id, donor_id,dgm_id,
 :banner.prog_name,:global.chapter_id
 from donor_reel where session_id = :find_donors.session_id;

 FOR dnr_holds_rec in dnr_holds loop /* This loop is created by Edwin */

 Place_donor_holds(dnr_holds_rec.donor_id,'NODON',null); /***place a hold on graded donors **/
 place_ddi_ddt(dnr_holds_rec.donor_id); /** place ddi/ddt hold on graded donors **/


 if :donations.deferral_reason not in('0','99') then
 place_donor_holds(dnr_holds_rec.donor_id,'DRDEF',null);
 elsif :donations.deferral_reason='99' then
 place_donor_holds(dnr_holds_rec.donor_id,'NODEF',null);
 end if;
 
 END LOOP;

 ---- Place_donor_holds(:find_donors.donor_id,'NODON');/***place a hold on donors for selection****/

ELSE /* if the key data is not entered in the find donor block , graded donations table is populated with null key data - Modified by Edwin */

 Insert into graded_donations(TRANSACTION_ID,CHAPTER_ID,UNIT_ID,ACTIVE_FLAG,PROGRAM_ID)
 values (:donations.transaction_id,:global.chapter_id,szTmpUnitId,'A',:banner.prog_name);
END IF;

exception
 when value_error then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;

 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_DONATION_HOLDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE place_donation_holds(int_code in varchar2) IS
 inter_found varchar2(1) := 'N';
 szScreenUnitId varchar2(15);
BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then -- Added by Edwin on 04-25-2001
 szScreenUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szScreenUnitId:=:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 End if;


 :global.temp := :system.cursor_item;
 GO_BLOCK('DONATION_INTERDICTIONS');
 GO_RECORD(1);

 IF :INTER_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
 LOOP
 If :DONATION_INTERDICTIONS.INTER_CODE = INT_CODE THEN
 inter_found := 'F';
 EXIT;
 End IF;
 If :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 Else
 NEXT_RECORD;
 End if;
 END LOOP;

 ELSE
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := szScreenUnitId;
 inter_found := 'F';
 END IF;

 IF inter_found = 'N' then
 If :INTER_CODE IS NULL THEN
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := szScreenUnitId;
 Else
 next_record;
 select inter_desc into :donation_interdictions.comments from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = int_code and inter_type = 'HOLDS'; 

 :donation_interdictions.inter_code := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.check := int_code;
 :donation_interdictions.unit_id := szScreenUnitId;
 End if;
 GO_ITEM(:GLOBAL.TEMP);

 Else
 GO_ITEM(:GLOBAL.TEMP);
 End if;

exception
 when No_data_found then
 message('Contacts IS');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_BLEED_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_bleed_time (date_in IN DATE, time_in IN DATE )RETURN boolean IS
/* added this function for SCR 12040 */
 l_sysdate_dt DATE;
 l_bleed_dt DATE;
BEGIN
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 l_sysdate_dt := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,SYSDATE); 
 ELSE
 l_sysdate_dt := SYSDATE;
 END IF;

 l_bleed_dt := TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(date_in, 'MM-DD-YYYY') || ' ' || TO_CHAR(time_in, 'HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 -- IF entered date is greater than SYSDATE (local or gmt)
 IF l_bleed_dt >= l_sysdate_dt THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPU_TERM_DATE

PROCEDURE compu_term_date(pl_hold_code in varchar2,pl_incident_date in date,
 pl_term_date out date) IS

 v_fixed_period VARCHAR2(2);
 v_period_type VARCHAR2(8);
 v_period_number NUMBER:=0;
 v_minimum_period NUMBER:=0;
