 v_status VARCHAR2(200);

BEGIN
 select fixed_period,period_type,period_number,minimum_period into
 v_fixed_period,v_period_type,v_period_number,v_minimum_period from
 valid_interdictions where inter_code=pl_hold_code and inter_type='HOLDS';

 DON_INTER.COMPUTE_TERM_DATE(trunc(sysdate),v_fixed_period,v_period_type,v_period_number,
 v_minimum_period,pl_incident_date,null,v_term_date,v_status);

 if substr(v_status,1,2)='OK' then 
 pl_term_date:=v_term_date;
 ---message('Term date:'||to_char(v_term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));pause;
 else
 show_error('16171',pl_hold_code);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

EXCEPTION
 when others then
 message('Error location COMPU_TERM_DATE Proc :' ||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE unit_Validation(pl_current_unit in VARCHAR2, pl_first_unit in VARCHAR2, pl_last_unit in VARCHAR2) IS

 iTempLastEnterd Number;
BEGIN

 If :GLOBAL.code_scheme ='I' then
 iTempLastEnterd:= to_number( substr(:ctrl_block_1.Last_unit_entered,6,8));
 Else

 iTempLastEnterd:= to_number(substr(:ctrl_block_1.Last_unit_entered, -5));
 else
 iTempLastEnterd:= to_number(:ctrl_block_1.Last_unit_entered);
 end if;

 End if;

 IF not ( to_number(pl_current_unit) between to_number(pl_first_unit) and to_number(pl_last_unit)) then

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 previous_item;

 bell;

 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 go_block('find_donors');
 END IF; 
 else
 go_block('find_donors');
 end if; 

 End if;
 END IF;
END;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' then --- For ISBT

 NULL;
 ELSE
 If not(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id between :ctrl_block_1.first_no and :ctrl_block_1.last_no) then

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id','E');
 previous_item;

 show_error('16006'); --check if out of range CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 Else
 If :ctrl_block_1.Last_unit_entered is null then --(Very first unit)

 if :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.first_no then

 else

 end if;

 Else --- if last entered unit id is not null (following units in the bunch)

 if (to_number(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id)- 1) != to_number(:ctrl_block_1.Last_unit_entered) then

 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ONLINE_DONATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- new code added for SCR# 16204 added by Touqeer Dated: 02/15/2010
PROCEDURE check_online_donation IS
 tempTrans donations.transaction_id%TYPE;
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300) := 'Donor was registered in the Onsite Module. DO you want to release the previous donations?'; 
 alert_id Alert; 
 alert_button Number; 
 
BEGIN
 
 SELECT transaction_id
 INTO temptrans
 FROM donations
 WHERE donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:drive_date)
 AND program_id = 'ONPLKREG' 
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

--'Donor was registered in the Onsite Module. DO you want to release the previous donations?'
 alert_id := FIND_ALERT ('YES_OR_NO');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY (alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := SHOW_ALERT (alert_id);


 IF alert_button = alert_button1
 THEN
 DELETE FROM donation_interdictions
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;
 
 DELETE FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans; 

 DELETE FROM online_status
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans; 
 
 DELETE FROM health_history
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;

 DELETE FROM physical_findings
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;

 DELETE FROM graded_donations
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;

 DELETE FROM graded_donors
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;

 DELETE FROM donations
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/26/2010. IM 3157
 DELETE FROM inter_transactions
 WHERE transaction_id = temptrans;
 -- End of change
 END IF;

 IF alert_button = alert_button2
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.id_queue := ''; --- Added by Touqeer for IM-3117 
 clear_form_blocks;
 /********* clears all except control block ************/
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 handle_error;
--- stop
END;

 --

ProgramUnit.Name: BLEED_START_TIME_KNI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE bleed_start_time_kni (bleed_start_time_in IN DATE, arm_code_in IN VARCHAR2)IS
 d_drive_start_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_drive_end_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_local_drive_start_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 d_local_drive_end_dt DATE; -- SCR 12040
 v_bleed_start_dt VARCHAR2(18); -- SCR 12040
 d_bleed_start_dt date; -- SCR 12040
 v_allowed_drive_date VARCHAR2(18);
 v_mid_night_crossing VARCHAR2(2);
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300):= 'Bleed start time inconsistant with drive date - Should collection date be set to forward/backward?';
 alert_id Alert;
 alert_button NUMBER;
BEGIN
 GLOBAL_VAR.gb_dispError := TRUE; -- Used in ON-ERROR to allow to display time format errors.
 
 IF bleed_start_time_in IS NOT NULL THEN 
 IF NOT(check_bleed_time(:donations.b_start_date, bleed_start_time_in )) THEN -- SCR 12040 
 show_error('16068');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 -- Below is for L2 and R2 specific only.......
 IF arm_code_in = 'L2' THEN
 IF not(check_stick_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,:donations.bleed_start_time_L2)) then
 show_error('16069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R2' THEN 
 IF not(check_stick_time(:donations.bleed_start_time_R1,:donations.bleed_start_time_R2)) then
 show_error('16069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 -------------
 
 /******** Check the actual/scheduled start time if the drive * **************/ 
 -- SCR 12040
 SELECT NVL(actual_start_time,schedule_start_time), NVL(actual_end_time, schedule_end_time)INTO d_drive_start_dt, d_drive_end_dt
 FROM drives
 WHERE drive_id = :ctrl_block_1.drive_id
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
 ----
 
 -- SCR 12040
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,d_drive_start_dt, d_local_drive_start_dt);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,d_drive_end_dt, d_local_drive_end_dt);
 ELSE
 d_local_drive_start_dt := d_drive_start_dt;
 d_local_drive_end_dt := d_drive_end_dt;
 END IF;
 
 
 -- SCR 12040
 v_bleed_start_dt := TO_CHAR(:donations.b_start_date,'mm-dd-yy') ||' '|| TO_CHAR(bleed_start_time_in,'HH24:mi');
 d_bleed_start_dt := TO_DATE( v_bleed_start_dt, 'mm-dd-yy hh24:mi');
 ---
 
 IF d_bleed_start_dt NOT BETWEEN d_local_drive_start_dt AND d_local_drive_end_dt THEN -- SCR 12040
 DECLARE
 alert_info lt_alert.payload_rt;
 BEGIN
 alert_info.title := NULL;
 alert_info.message := err_txt;
 alert_info.alert_style := 'Stop';
 alert_info.button1_lbl := 'Forward';
 alert_info.button2_lbl := 'Backward';
 alert_info.button3_lbl := 'Cancel';
 alert_info.default_button := 'Button3';
 lt_alert.init_alert(alert_info);
 CALL_FORM( LOWER('utwalert.fmx') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE); 
 
 IF lt_alert.button1 THEN
 IF d_bleed_start_dt+1 >= LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_LOCAL_TIME(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, SYSDATE) THEN
 show_error('16166');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 IF lt_alert.button2 THEN
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date -1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item; 
 END IF;
 
 IF lt_alert.button3 THEN
 next_item; 
 END IF;
 END; 
 /*
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_NO');
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt );
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );
 -- SCR 12040
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 IF d_bleed_start_dt+1 >= LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_LOCAL_TIME(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, SYSDATE) THEN
 show_error('16166');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 --

 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 :donations.b_start_date := :donations.b_start_date -1;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON3 THEN
 next_item;
 END IF;
 */
 ELSE
 :donations.b_start_date := :ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date;
 next_item;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
WHEN value_error THEN
 MESSAGE(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE(sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: BLEED_END_TIME_KNI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE BLEED_END_TIME_KNI (bleed_end_time_in IN DATE, arm_code_in IN VARCHAR2)IS
 temp VARCHAR2(5);
 alert_id ALERT;
 alert_button NUMBER;
 alert_msg VARCHAR2(100):= 'Possible illogical bleed time - Place hold ?';
 start_time NUMBER;
 end_time NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 GLOBAL_VAR.gb_dispError := TRUE;
 IF bleed_end_time_in IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NOT(check_bleed_time(:donations.b_start_date, bleed_end_time_in )) THEN -- SCR 12040 
 show_error('16068');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF arm_code_in = 'L1' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_L1,'hh24mi'));
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'L2' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_L2,'hh24mi')); 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R1' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_R1,'hh24mi'));
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'R2' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.bleed_start_time_R2,'hh24mi')); 
 ELSIF arm_code_in = 'O' THEN
 start_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(:donations.other_bleed_s_time,'hh24mi')); 
 END IF;
 
 end_time:=to_number(TO_CHAR(bleed_end_time_in,'hh24mi'));
 
 IF end_time < start_time THEN
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_OR_NO');
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, alert_msg);
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 temp := get_RHOLD('ILIGLBLEED');
 IF temp != '***' THEN
 place_donation_holds(temp);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 :donations.b_end_date := :donations.b_start_date +1;
 next_item;
 ELSE
 temp := get_RHOLD('ILIGLBLEED');
 IF temp != '***' THEN
 REMOVE_HOLDS(TEMP);
 END IF;
 next_item;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 next_item;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
WHEN value_error THEN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_RHOLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_RHOLD(p_reason IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 lv_interCode VARCHAR2(5);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 SELECT NVL(inter_code,'***')
 INTO lv_interCode
 FROM VALID_REGINT_REASONS
 WHERE inter_reason = p_reason
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate +1);
 
 RETURN lv_interCode;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_AGE_LIMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_age_limit(nAge in NUMBER) IS
 nAgeLow NUMBER:=To_Number(LTRim(:GLOBAL.AGE_LOW));
 nAgeUpper NUMBER:=To_Number(LTRim(:GLOBAL.AGE_UPPER));
 alert_id NUMBER;
 vError VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN

 If nAge < nAgeLow then
 SELECT error into vError from valid_errors where error_code='21042' and rownum =1;
 set_alert_property('age_alert',alert_message_text,vError);
 alert_id:=show_alert('age_alert');
 If alert_id=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 NULL;
 Else
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 End if;

 Elsif nAge > nAgeUpper then
 SELECT error into vError from valid_errors where error_code='21043' and rownum =1;
 set_alert_property('age_alert',alert_message_text,vError);
 alert_id:=show_alert('age_alert');
 If alert_id=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 NULL;
 Else
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 End if;

 Else
 Null;
 End if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_AREA_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_area_code(p_areaCode IN VARCHAR2) is -- MLT 1284
 chk_cnt number;
 chp_sysdate date;
begin
 if p_areaCode is not null then
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,
 sysdate,
 chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- 
 
 select count(*)
 into chk_cnt
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'AREAC'
 and code = p_areaCode
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);
 
 if chk_cnt <= 0 then
 show_error('9207');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end validate_area_code;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EMAIL_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_EMAIL_local
 (pl_email in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 If ltrim(UPPER(pl_email),'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ1234567890_-@.') is not null then 
 show_error ('16189');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif (substr(pl_email,-4,1)='.' or substr(pl_email,-3,1)='.') then 
 if instr(pl_email,'@',1) = 0 then 
 show_error ('16189');
 else
 null;
 end if;
 Else
 show_error ('16189');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIXED_SITE_STAFF
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct
a.staff_no,
a.Last_name 
from 
employees a,
drives b,
fixed_site_staff c
where b.drive_type='F'
and a.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
and b.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CITY

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_CITY

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EMPLOYERS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
a.employer_name, 
a.employer_id, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_postal_code, b.zip) ZIP, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_city, b.city) CITY, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_state, b.state) STATE,
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_country_name, 'USA') COUNTRY,
a.usps_id 
from donor_employers a , valid_city_state b 
where a.usps_id = b.usps_id 
and employer_name like '%'||:donor_addresses.employer_name||'%' 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)+1) 
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
order by 1,4,3

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ALTID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select code,description from valid_master_codes where
code_type='ALTID' and sysdate between eff_date and
nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41008 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------
 elsif error_code = 41009 --Function key not allowed
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41051 --Can not create records here
 then
 show_error('12038');
 ----------------------------------------------------------
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

DECLARE

 alert_button Number; 

BEGIN
:GLOBAL.cue_permitted:=NULL;
If :ctrl_block_1.set_id is null or :total = 0 then
 erase_global_addr;
 exit_form(no_validate);
Else
 
 IF :GLOBAL.BATCH_REGISTER='Y' then -- This was added by Edwin on 04-09-2001

 if :ctrl_block_1.last_unit_entered != :ctrl_block_1.last_no then 
 alert_id := Find_Alert('YES_OR_NO'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt ); 
 alert_button := Show_Alert( alert_id );

 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF; 
 IF alert_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN 
 run_setid_report;
 for i in 1..2000 loop
 null;
 end loop;
 erase_global_addr; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 END IF; 
 else
 run_setid_report; 
 for i in 1..2000 loop
 null;
 end loop;
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 ELSE -- If not batch mode (Don't generate any report for non-batcvh registration)
 --run_setid_report; 
 -- for i in 1..2000 loop
 -- null;
 -- end loop;
 erase_global_addr;
 exit_form(no_validate);
 END IF;

End If;
END;
